title: 第9章 杨康8第10章 杨康9
content_zh:
欧阳锋听着杨康的问题，虽然觉得莫名其妙，但还是回答“郭靖老实人一个，简直是个傻小子，黄蓉那丫头倒是古灵精怪，不过眼光却不太好！”
是的！欧阳锋对于黄蓉嫌弃自家侄儿，却看上郭靖这个傻小子耿耿于怀！
虽然他只是为了谋夺九阴真经而求娶黄蓉，黄蓉只是顺便的，但自家侄儿和白驼山庄却不是她能侮辱的。
当日他看在黄药师和洪七公的面子上没有深究，但这并不代表他心里完全不在意。
毕竟白驼山庄是欧阳家的传承，欧阳克更是自家唯一的传人。黄蓉侮辱他们，何尝不是在侮辱他！
杨康看着欧阳锋的神色，瞬间明白了他的想法。欧阳锋在高处太久，早就养成了唯我独尊的性子，他估计也没想到郭靖这个老实人会骗他！
“欧阳前辈，郭靖确实是个老实人，但洪七公和黄蓉可不是！九阴真经到底如何我们谁都不清楚，万一他们篡改呢！毕竟人心隔肚皮啊！”
“老乞丐一向光明磊落，应该不会这么做吧？”
“您觉得呢？中神通王重阳还是侠义人士呢，不照样假死骗您，让您退回西域二十年吗？”
看着杨康脸上淡淡的讽刺，欧阳锋瞬间觉得脸疼！
没错！被王重阳骗了这件事是他一辈子的耻辱！虽然他确实在王重阳垂危之际抢夺经书，但当日比武说的很清楚，武力最高者保管九阴真经，既然如此，那他找王重阳抢夺经书也没有问题啊！
虽然趁人之危不合适，但他确实是以武力抢的啊！
杨康对于欧阳锋的行为没什么要评价的！无论是君子还是小人，每个人都有自己的生活方式，拿自己的标准去要求别人，本身就不合适！
“自古天下武学出少林，少林历经千年而不衰败，欧阳前辈没想过原因吗？”
“不过一群乌合之众罢了”
杨康倒也没准备将逍遥派武学给欧阳锋，毕竟欧阳锋虽然痴迷武学，但本人确实不好控制，少林武学也不差，而且还能平心静气，引人向善，这多适合欧阳锋啊！
杨康倒也没有反驳欧阳锋，毕竟在天下五绝的光环面前，现在的少林确实有一些拿不出手。
“少林历经千年岁月，或许一时落寞了，但底蕴却不可估量！毕竟昔日名动一时的南慕容，北乔峰都已经成为过往云烟。前辈出身世家，自然明白底蕴传承的重要！”
“九阴真经确实名动江湖，令天下人争夺，但其他武学却未必比不上它！”
听着杨康的话，欧阳锋倒是陷入了沉思，他出生白驼山庄，自然知道一些陈年往事。

南慕容或许名不副实，但北乔峰当日位居辽国南院大王，降龙十八掌更是炉火纯青。其在少林一战中尚且未能带走父亲，由此可见少林也不是徒有虚名！
看着欧阳锋意动的样子，杨康直接加了一把火。
“南帝出身大理皇室，其祖段誉更是当日乔峰义弟，在大理天龙寺求得六脉神剑，虽然大理皇室现在已经失传了这门武学，但一阳指却还在，前辈难道还不明白吗？”
“有的时候名声并不重要，重要的是到手东西的价值！”
content_en:
Ouyang Feng listened to Yang Kang's question. Although he felt puzzled, he still answered, "Guo Jing is an honest man, he is just a stupid boy. That girl Huang Rong is quite weird, but her vision is not very good!"
Yes! Ouyang Feng resented Huang Rong for his nephew, but he fell in love with Guo Jing, a silly boy!
Although he only asked to marry Huang Rong in order to seize the Nine Yin Scriptures, and Huang Rong was just doing it by the way, her nephew and White Camel Villa were not something she could insult.
That day, he didn't look into it for the sake of Huang Yaoshi and Hong Qigong, but that didn't mean he didn't care at all.
After all, White Camel Villa is the inheritance of the Ouyang family, and Ouyang Ke is the only descendant of his family. When Huang Rong insulted them, she was not insulting him!
Yang Kang looked at Ouyang Feng's expression and instantly understood what he was thinking. Ouyang Feng had been in a high place for too long and had long developed a self-centered personality. He probably didn't expect that Guo Jing, an honest man, would lie to him!
"Senior Ouyang, Guo Jing is indeed an honest man, but Hong Qigong and Huang Rong are not! None of us know what the Nine Yin Manual is about, what if they tamper with it! After all, people's hearts are separated from each other!"
"The old beggar has always been upright, so he shouldn't do this, right?"
"What do you think? The supernatural king Chongyang is still a chivalrous person. Why not fake his own death to trick you and let you return to the Western Regions for twenty years?"
Seeing the faint sarcasm on Yang Kang's face, Ouyang Feng felt his face hurt instantly!
That's right! Being deceived by Wang Chongyang will be a lifelong shame for him! Although he did snatch the scriptures from Wang Chongyang when he was dying, the martial arts competition that day made it very clear that the one with the highest martial arts would keep the Nine Yin Scriptures. If that was the case, then there was no problem for him to snatch the scriptures from Wang Chongyang!
Although it was inappropriate to take advantage of someone's danger, he did use force to rob it!
Yang Kang has nothing to comment on Ouyang Feng's behavior! Whether he is a gentleman or a villain, everyone has his own way of life. It is inappropriate to ask others according to your own standards!
"Since ancient times, martial arts all over the world originated from Shaolin. Shaolin has endured for thousands of years without declining. Hasn't Senior Ouyang thought about the reason?"
"Just a bunch of rabble"
Yang Kang was not prepared to teach Ouyang Feng the Xiaoyao martial arts. After all, although Ouyang Feng was obsessed with martial arts, he was really difficult to control. Shaolin martial arts was not bad, and he could also be calm and lead people to do good. This was very suitable for Ouyang Feng!
Yang Kang did not refute Ouyang Feng. After all, in the face of the aura of the Five Ultimates in the World, the current Shaolin does have some things it can't do.
"Shaolin may have been lonely for a while after thousands of years, but its heritage is immeasurable! After all, Nan Murong and Beiqiao Peak, who were famous in the past, have become a thing of the past. My predecessors came from a noble family, so they naturally understand the importance of inheriting their heritage!"
"The Nine Yin Manual is indeed famous in the world and people all over the world are competing for it, but other martial arts may not be as good as it!"
Listening to Yang Kang's words, Ouyang Feng fell into deep thought. He was born in White Camel Villa, so he naturally knew some old events.
Nan Murong may not live up to his name, but Bei Qiao Feng was the king of the South Academy of Liao Kingdom at that time, and he was even more proficient in the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms. He was still unable to take away his father in the Shaolin battle, which shows that Shaolin is not in vain!
Seeing Ouyang Feng's agitated look, Yang Kang directly added fuel to the fire.
"The Southern Emperor was born in the Dali royal family, and his ancestor Duan Yu was Qiao Feng's sworn brother. He obtained the Six Meridians Divine Sword at the Tianlong Temple in Dali. Although the Dali royal family has lost this martial arts, the Yiyang Finger is still there. Don't you understand, senior?"
"Sometimes reputation is not important, what is important is the value of the thing you get!"
